# I8 · Khóa thời gian phòng

Group **I · Vận hành Clinic · bổ sung từ web** · detail screen · status: **ported**

> Web › resources › Khóa phòng · chỉ lưu khi không vướng lịch

## Logic source
- Web: resources › Khóa phòng · chỉ lưu khi không vướng lịch
- Web-only: logic ported from `prototype/shared/*.js` into the `shared/clinic` domain (`ClinicStore`, `transact` commands, `ClinicError` errors keep the web's Vietnamese messages).
- Permissions follow `prototype/shared/staff-context.js` (`pages` + `capabilities`) → `Session.allows` + `session.staffContext().can(...)`.
- Web `operations-ui.js` › resources() save-block; `ClinicStore.block` (08:00–18:00, reason required, must not clash with appointments).

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.RoomBlock` ("room-block") · app bar "Khóa thời gian phòng"
- Composable: `RoomBlockScreen` — `pema-kmp/feature/operations/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/operations/OperationsGraph.kt`
- Registered by graph: `operationsGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `addDays`, `block`, `clearPreparedCrmBooking`, `crmQueue`, `initials`, `minutes`, `money`, `patient`, `preparedCrmBookingInput`, `reception`, `saveAppointment`, `staffContext`, `time`, `updateService`, `validate`, `viDate`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/operations/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/operations/OperationsShotTest.kt:54` → `pema-kmp/feature/operations/build/shots/I8-vs.png`
- Canvas image: (run `gradlew canvasRefs`)
